title: React.js SPA (Vite + TanStack Query)
summary: React 19 / 18, Vite, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, TanStack Query v5, Zustand
rules: Organize by feature domain: src/features/[feature]/components/, api/, hooks/.
Server State vs Client State: TanStack Query v5 for ALL server data; Zustand ONLY for local/global UI state.
Negative Constraint: NEVER duplicate server state in Zustand or useState.
Negative Constraint on useEffect: Do NOT use useEffect for data fetching or computing derived state.
Always use Query Key Factories to ensure deterministic cache invalidation.
